config.design: Fixed16families x8 source slots x2formats, paired answer-changing examples. Native competence only; no circuit/featurizer claims. Save all outcomes and tokenization exclusions. No equal-length filter at competence stage; alignment handled later.
config.split: A first4 source discovery, A last4 lexical, B first4 structural, B last4 joint. Whole-task training holdouts predeclared: sequence_copy,role_binding,spatial_inverse,tense. These are development holdouts, not the original reserved test.
config.gate: Per family/split >=4 DISTINCT prompt pairs, >=.75 both-endpoint contrast correctness, >=.5 intended group full-vocabulary top1. Duplicated templates counted once; all are reported, no posthoc prompt replacement.
config.groups: Existing fixed agreement/sentiment/negation semantic groups; otherwise exact answer tokens. Strict single-token continuation boundary check; excluded pairs retained in report.
config.limits: Some prompts reuse prior research. Eight source slots do not imply lexical independence across all task families. Semantic ambiguities and tokenization can make a format unsuitable without proving inability.
config.purpose: Screen breadth cheaply before expensive causal targets; no new training.
